🚀 About the role

We're looking for a Founder Associate to work side by side with our CEO and make FLEXeCHARGE run better every week. Our HARMON-E platform manages load and energy for EV charging operators across Europe, built by a highly specialised team in Copenhagen and Germany.

You'll split your time between three things: driving company priorities with the CEO, owning our People function, and running our Copenhagen office. You'll get things done day to day, and you'll find smarter ways of working through better systems and automation.

You'll be part of our Admin & General team, which also includes Finance. You'll work closely with your colleagues there every day, from payroll and budgets to vendor agreements and board material, so strong collaboration is a core part of the role.

⚡ What is special about this role

You'll sit at the centre of the company. You'll work directly with the CEO, see how decisions get made in a growing climate-tech scale-up, and own the follow-through that turns those decisions into results.

You're also our People function. You'll shape how we hire, onboard, develop and celebrate our team, and how our Frederiksberg office looks and feels. You'll organise the moments that bring us together, from Friday bars and workshops to company events.

Few roles give you this much exposure this early. If you like ownership, move fast and want to learn how a company is built from the inside, this is the seat for it. And you'll join a team of genuinely fun, innovative people who care about doing great work together.

🛠️ What you'll do

Roughly 40% strategy and execution with the CEO, 35% culture and workplace, 25% People operations. The mix will shift with the company's needs.

Strategy & execution with the CEO

• Co-design our next scaling phase. Shape the organisational development of the company together with the CEO.

• Own the alignment. Prepare leadership, management and all-hands meetings, capture decisions and make sure actions are closed.

• Lead strategic projects. Run high-priority initiatives end to end, backed by research and a clear recommendation.

• Support the CEO. Prepare board and investor material, manage priorities and calendar, and follow up with stakeholders.

People operations

• Lead recruitment end to end and build a hiring process that scales.

• Be the go-to for People questions on contracts, leave, benefits and policies, employee handbook, and handle sensitive matters confidentially.

• Run the review and development cycle, from remuneration reviews to development talks.

• Keep People admin running and improving: payroll for Denmark and Germany, the employee handbook, our work environment organisation (AMO) and compliance, and smarter systems.

Culture & workplace

• Turn our values into everyday practice through onboarding, recognition and internal communication, including the all-hands and company updates.

• Bring the team together with events and workshops, from Friday bars to the Christmas dinner.

• Keep our Copenhagen office welcoming and running, including supplies and service providers.

✅ What we're looking for

Must-have

• 1–4 years of experience in a fast-paced role such as startup operations, People operations, consulting, a founder's office or a graduate programme.

• A strong get-it-done mentality: you take ownership, move quickly and close loops without being chased.

• Structured thinking: you can take a messy problem, break it down and come back with a clear recommendation.

• Excellent organisational skills, discretion with confidential information and the ability to juggle priorities independently.

• Comfort with data and tools: you're confident in spreadsheets and slides, and you look for ways to automate repetitive work.

• Fluent written and spoken English. Danish or German are a strong preference.

Nice to have

• Working knowledge of Danish employment law and People practices.

• Experience with office management or workplace coordination.

• An interest in energy, climate tech or EV charging.

• Hands-on recruitment experience, from job posting to signed contract.

📈 Where this role can grow

This role grows with you and with the company. As you prove yourself, you'll take on bigger projects and more ownership.

• Toward Chief of Staff, owning company planning and the leadership agenda as the team scales.

• Toward Head of People, building out the People function as we grow across Denmark and Germany.

• Into a business role, such as operations, partnerships or customer success, once you know the company inside out.

You'll have regular development talks with the CEO to decide which direction fits you best.

🌆 What is it like to work at FLEXeCHARGE?

• Our office is in Frederiksberg: bright, comfortable, and a genuinely nice place to spend your workday.

• You're covered with pension contributions.

• Lunch is served on-site, and it's delicious, healthy and nutritious.

• We enjoy each other's company outside work too, with Friday bars, company events and team-building activities.

• You'll have opportunities for individual development, with a clear view of how the company is run.

🤝 Our interview process

Here's what happens once we've had a look at your application:

• A 30-minute screening call with our CEO.

• A practical stage: a short case exercise on a real business or People challenge, followed by a discussion at our office.

• Meeting the team.

Hiring carefully matters to us. We want to get to know you properly, and we want you to get a real feel for us too. If there's anything we can do to make the process work better for you, tell us.

We'd love to hear from you.

📍 Location & practical details

This is an on-site role based in Copenhagen. Only candidates currently located in Copenhagen, or those who clearly state in their application that they plan to relocate, will be considered.

Please note:

• We do not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

• We do not offer relocation services.

🔐 Data privacy (GDPR)

• Applications for this role are processed exclusively through The Hub (thehub.io), our recruitment platform, in accordance with their privacy policy and applicable GDPR requirements. As part of our interview process, conversations may be recorded and transcribed via Microsoft Teams, and AI tools may be used to summarise interview notes to support our hiring team's evaluation. Your data will be handled confidentially, retained only during the interview process, and used only for this recruitment process.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc Position: Adaptive and Distributed Foundation Model Inference across the Computing Continuum
jobs.description:
Postdoc Position: Adaptive and Distributed Foundation Model Inference across the Computing Continuum
We are seeking highly motivated and talented applicants for a 2-year postdoctoral position (with the possibility of extension) in the area of distributed foundation model inference.

Join us at the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Aarhus University, where we are advancing resource-efficient and distributed foundation model inference across the computing continuum, leveraging the computation resources at Edge and Cloud. Our research aims to enable scalable, low-latency, and resource-aware deployment of large foundation models.

Expected start date and duration of employment 
This is a full-time, fixed-term position for one year, starting on March 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

The initial appointment will run until Feb 28, 2029, or for 24 months from the actual start date.

Job description
• The successful candidate will contribute to cutting-edge research on topics including:
• Distributed and collaborative inference strategies;
• Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) placement and scheduling for inference acceleration;
• Token compression or Intermediate feature compression;
• Resource-aware and communication-efficient inference optimization.

You will work in a dynamic and collaborative research environment, with opportunities to publish in top-tier venues and collaborate with leading academic and industry partners within the Horizion Europe Project.

Your profile
We are looking for a highly motivated and talented candidate with a background in deep learning. The required qualifications include:

• Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field;
• Strong background in Deep Learning (e.g., Transformers, foundation models);
• Strong programming skills in Python and experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch);
• Experience with distributed systems and edge AI;
• Strong publication record in reputable conferences or journals relative to career stage;
• Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

Following qualifications will be considered as an advantage:

• Experience in working with stream data;
• Experience with collaborative, cross-cultural research environments.
Who we are
You will be based at the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE) at Aarhus University, a dynamic and growing department committed to excellence in research, education, and innovation. Our research spans Internet of things, machine learning, signal processing, to digital twins, all with a strong emphasis on high impact research and societal relevance.

This position will be supervised by Professor Qi Zhang, whose current research focuses on Edge Intelligence, Distributed Foundation Model inference, Internet of Things and Analytics on compressed data.

What we offer
We offer a vibrant and inclusive research environment with a clear commitment to real-world impact. Denmark is consistently ranked among the best countries in the world for work-life balance and quality of life. Family-friendly policies include generous parental leave, subsidised childcare, and access to excellent public healthcare and education. As a postdoc at Aarhus University, you will benefit from a supportive and flexible workplace culture that values diversity and offers excellent conditions for researchers and their families.

Specifically, we offer:

• Access to state-of-the-art facilities and computing infrastructure;
• Strong support for research career development, including mentoring and international networking opportunities;
• A commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of our work;
• A workplace characterised by professionalism, equality and a healthy work-life balance.
Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is Helsingforsgade 10, 8200 Aarhus N, and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments.

Contact information
For further information, please contact: Professor Qi Zhang, +4541893253, qz@ece.au.dk.

Deadline
Applications must be submitted by December 6th, 2026.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self. 

Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

Om Aarhus Universitet

Aarhus Universitet er et fagligt bredt og forskningsintensivt universitet med høj kvalitet i uddannelse og forskning, og et stærkt engagement i samfundsudviklingen nationalt og globalt. Universitetet tilbyder et inspirerende uddannelses- og forskningsmiljø for 37.500 studerende inklusive ph.d.-studerende og har 9.000 medarbejdere opgjort i årsværk samt en årlig omsætning på 8,9 mia. kr. _Are you passionate about ensuring complex IoT and connectivity solutions perform reliably before reaching customers? Do you thrive at the intersection of system architecture, embedded firmware, verification, and AI? And do you want to help shape the future of verification and validation for connected products in a modern engineering organization?

Working closely with Solution Architects, Systems Engineers, Firmware Developers, and Hardware Engineers, you will drive verification activities across disciplines and help shape the future of testing within the Water Division.

• Defining and driving the verification strategy throughout the product lifecycle

• Leading verification activities across firmware, hardware, connectivity, and integrated solutions

• Ensuring traceability, test coverage, and alignment from requirements to release readiness

• Driving AI-enabled verification, test automation, and modern quality engineering practices

Combine hands-on technical impact with strategic influence as you drive verification excellence, shape future testing practices, and help bring innovative connected solutions safely to market.

**Reporting to the Director of Connectivity, you will join the Solutions Architect team within the Water Division. Working alongside specialists in connectivity, embedded systems, wireless communication, system architecture, and product development, you will help ensure our solutions are verified and validated before release.

You will be part of an informal and collaborative environment characterized by strong technical expertise, knowledge sharing, and a shared commitment to delivering high-quality solutions to our customers.

Combining analytical thinking with a pragmatic approach, you are comfortable challenging assumptions, identifying risks, and driving quality through collaboration, automation, and emerging technologies.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, Electronics Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, and have experience testing embedded, firmware-based, connected, or IoT products

Are you passionate about supply chain planning within an End-2-End perspective and motivated by making operational decisions that create value across the entire value chain? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where customer focus, stakeholder management and data-driven decision-making go hand in hand? Then this could be the opportunity for you. We are looking for an Operational Network Planner for CBP Krusaa cluster.

“Joining the Krusaa Cluster Planning team, you will be part of planning the supply of speciality cheese products across a complex and dynamic supply chain. Working closely with Supply Chain, Commercial and Production, you will help connect customer demand with production and supply. If you thrive in an operational environment, enjoy collaborating across functions and want to make a real impact, this could be the opportunity for you” says Christine Carstensen, Supply Chain Network Planning Manager.

The role can be based either in Krusaa or Viby J. To support close collaboration with the planning team and production sites, colleagues based in Viby J are expected to spend a minimum of one day per week in Krusaa.

Read more about Supply Chain at Arla here Inside Arla.

How you will make an impact

As an Operational Network Planner, you will play a key role within the Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) horizon, ensuring that we deliver excellent service levels to customers while balancing production capacity, inventory levels and waste reduction across markets and warehouses.

You will join a highly collaborative planning team consisting of 6 Site Schedulers, two Operational Network Planners and one Component Planner, supporting five production sites. Working closely with colleagues across Supply Chain, Commercial and Production, you will help drive operational decisions that create value across the end-to-end supply chain.

Your key responsibilities will include

• Optimizing supply chain performance through root cause analysis and data-driven decisions.

• Monitoring relevant KPIs and implementing corrective actions to achieve targets.

• Conducting scenario planning to mitigate availability risks, reduce waste, and assess the impact of demand fluctuations on finished goods.

• Escalating unresolved short-term imbalances to global or local S&OE executive forums and key stakeholders.

• Leading proactive dialogue between Supply Chain and Commercial teams to solve complex issues.

• Identifying and contributing to optimization initiatives from an end-to-end perspective.

What will make you successful

You are an ambitious and structured professional with strong analytical skills and the ability to work across multiple functions. You thrive on collaboration and have a natural ability to engage with stakeholders from across the business.

You are motivated by change and actively contribute to the continuous improvement of ways of working and collaboration.

We imagine you

• Hold a relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree within Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, Business or a related field.

• Have experience within supply chain planning, logistics or manufacturing, preferably working within S&OE or short-term planning horizons.

• Are comfortable analysing data and using insights to support operational decisions.

• Communicate clearly and confidently with stakeholders across different functions and organisational levels.

• Are curious, proactive and motivated by continuous improvement and optimisation.

• Are able to communicate effectively both in Danish and in English

An inclusive corporate culture that creates job satisfaction is important to us, and we prioritize giving our employees good development opportunities. We are looking for you who want to grow with us at Arla Foods!

Arla Foods has a collective agreement and always offers good and competitive working conditions. In addition, we have a high priority on safety and the working environment.

Shape the Future of Dairy

jobs.occupation: Head of Group Compliance & Group Data Protection Officer
jobs.description:
**Lead a global compliance function and help shape how compliance enables the business

**Are you an experienced compliance, privacy or GRC leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of regulation, business and technology?

Do you thrive in a role where you can set direction, lead experienced professionals, advise Executive Management and the Board, and turn complex requirements into practical solutions?

Then this could be your opportunity to lead Aeven's Group Compliance function.

**The role

**As Head of Group Compliance & Group Data Protection Officer, you will lead the Global Group Compliance organisation of approximately 27 professionals across four teams and three countries.

You will have overall responsibility for the strategy, direction and development of the function, covering:

• Group Data Protection and the DPO function

• Regulatory Compliance

• Enterprise Risk Management

• Internal Audit

• ISO and external assurance

• Customer and supplier assurance

• Responsibility / ESG

You will lead primarily through your managers, creating clear priorities and accountability while empowering highly specialised teams to own their areas.

The role combines strategic leadership, independent oversight and senior business advisory. You will work closely with Executive Management and the Board, providing a consolidated view of Aeven's compliance, privacy, risk and assurance position and highlighting where action or decisions are required.

At the same time, you will work closely with the business to translate regulatory and customer requirements into clear, proportionate and commercially workable solutions.

****Your responsibilities

• Set the strategy, priorities and roadmap for Group Compliance and lead, coach and develop the management team.

• Advise Executive Management and the Board on significant compliance, privacy and risk matters and provide clear, decision-oriented Management Information.

• Act as Group DPO and oversee Aeven's data protection framework, including significant privacy risks, breaches, regulatory engagement and international transfers.

• Lead the organisation's approach to regulatory developments, including GDPR, NIS2, DORA-related customer requirements, AI Act, Data Act and digital sovereignty.

• Own the Enterprise Risk Management framework and consolidated enterprise risk view, while ensuring risk ownership remains with the business.

• Oversee Internal Audit and Aeven's broader certification and assurance landscape, including ISO and ISAE activities.

• Provide senior oversight of customer and supplier due diligence, audits and regulatory assurance requirements.

• Support significant incidents, investigations, escalations and remediation across the organisation.

• Continuously develop and modernise the function through simplification, automation, better Management Information and effective use of compliance technology.

A key part of the role is ensuring that compliance enables the business rather than unnecessarily slowing it down.

****Your experience

****We are looking for an experienced leader who is comfortable operating where regulation, risk and business strategy meet.

You bring:

• A relevant Master's degree, for example in Law, Business/Commercial Law or a related field.

• 10+ years of experience within compliance, data protection, GRC or a related area, including several years leading managers and international or multi-disciplinary teams.

• Strong GDPR and data protection expertise, including DPO experience.

• Proven experience advising C-level executives and Boards and communicating complex risks through clear Management Information.

• Experience with Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Audit and assurance.

• Working knowledge of ISO management systems (ISO9001, ISO27001 and ISO14001) and ideally ISAE 3000/3402 reporting.

• Knowledge of EU digital and cyber regulation, including NIS2, DORA, AI Act and Data Act.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

Experience from an international, regulated or technology-driven organisation is an advantage, as is experience with privacy certification, GRC technology, customer assurance, ESG or transformation.

**Who You Are

**You are a trusted and credible advisor who can challenge senior stakeholders constructively while building strong relationships across the organisation.

You lead through trust, clear direction and empowerment, and enjoy developing managers and creating high-performing teams.

You are strategic but pragmatic, with strong business understanding and the judgement to balance regulatory robustness with commercial realities.

You communicate complex issues simply, drive follow-through and are comfortable raising risks and challenging established ways of working.

Most importantly, you bring integrity, sound judgement, independence and a genuine desire to make compliance work for the business.

Do you have the AI insight and business acumen to determine which technologies will create the greatest value for Arla in the years ahead?

This is a unique opportunity to lead the AI agenda, driving the transformation from experimentation to scaled adoption of AI, Copilot, and intelligent automation across the business.

“In this role you will influence the future of how more than 20,000 colleagues will benefit from emerging technologies across Arla. Your work will help identify the use cases that bring value, and the governance work you d__o will ensure a safe steer on the journey says Søren Bækgaard Hansen, Senior Director, CIO Office and Data Governance.

How you will make an impact

This role combines hands-on thought leadership with transformation execution. You will operate as a key driver in the CIO Office - shaping how AI is governed and embedded into everyday work.

As our new Senior IT Specialist you will take ownership of the AI governance framework and cross-functional collaboration model, ensuring that AI is used responsibly, effectively, and at scale across Arla. You will work closely with stakeholders across the business zones and functions, external partners, IT and senior leadership and act as a connector between strategy, governance, and delivery teams to drive tangible business value and outcomes.

In this role, you will

• Lead the end-to-end AI governance agenda, including policies, standards, and controls across Agents, Copilot, and automation use cases

• Drive business transformation through AI by identifying opportunities, shaping PoCs and MVPs, defining value cases, and leading the transition from experiments to scaled solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes

• Enable adoption of AI by defining clear frameworks, practical guidelines, and reusable patterns for business and IT product teams

• Partner with senior leaders to translate emerging AI opportunities into strategic decisions, roadmaps, and practical actions that create business value

• Facilitate workshops and drive collaboration across platform teams, architects, product teams, and business functions

• Lead communication and storytelling that builds confidence, clarity, and momentum around AI at Arla

What will make you successful

To succeed in this role, you bring solid experience driving AI, technology, or digital transformation initiatives in a complex organisation. Ideally, you have worked in a similar role within a large global company. Alternatively, you come from a consulting background where AI, emerging technologies, and business transformation have been a core part of your work.

You will join the CIO Office at Arla at a moment where AI is becoming a core capability across the Arla business.

We offer a highly visible role where you will help shape Arla’s AI and Agentic AI adoption journey. You will be part of a collaborative and forward-looking environment where innovation and execution go hand in hand, with opportunities to work with leading partners and technologies. You will also join a culture focused on learning, trust, and making a real impact, while helping define how AI creates value across one of the world’s leading dairy companies.

Application & contact

If you want to seize this exciting opportunity, please apply as soon as possible. For additional information, please contact Søren Bækgaard Hansen (sorha@arlafoods.com).

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

At Autorola Solutions, we're helping transform how the global automotive industry operates through digital solutions, technology and business process expertise.

We're looking for a Senior Business System Consultant to take a leading role in designing and delivering complex software solutions across customer engagements. Combining strong business process understanding with deep solution expertise, you'll translate business requirements into scalable, high-quality system solutions and take ownership of the technical approach from initial analysis through configuration, implementation and final validation.

As a senior member of the team, you'll be a trusted advisor to customers and an important sparring partner for Project Management Consultants, Software Development (ASYS), Product Management, Sales and our subsidiaries. You'll help shape solution designs, guide technical decisions, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure that customer needs are translated into practical, sustainable solutions that create lasting business value.

If you're passionate about solving complex business challenges, advising customers at a strategic and operational level, and driving high-quality software implementations, we'd love to hear from you.

**About Us

**The Autorola Group is a global leader in online vehicle remarketing, automotive IT solutions and business intelligence for the used vehicle market. Through Autorola Marketplace, Autorola Solutions and Indicata, we help manufacturers, leasing companies, fleet owners and dealers buy, sell and manage vehicles more efficiently using technology, data and digital solutions.

**Lead the design and delivery of smart, scalable solutions

**As Senior Business System Consultant, you'll take ownership of the technical solution throughout the customer engagement. Working in close partnership with a Project Management Consultant, who is responsible for the client relationship, project scope, planning and overall delivery, you'll lead the solution design and ensure that business requirements are translated into robust, scalable and maintainable system solutions.

You'll bring senior-level expertise to complex customer scenarios, advising on business processes, product capabilities and solution alternatives. You'll challenge requirements where appropriate, identify opportunities to leverage standard functionality, and help determine when configuration is sufficient and when further product development is needed.

Your role will extend beyond individual implementations. You'll contribute to improving our solution delivery practices, establish and promote best practices, share knowledge across the team and act as a trusted technical and functional sparring partner for colleagues. Where relevant, you'll also engage directly with customer business teams to ensure that solutions support real operational workflows and deliver the intended business outcomes.

Success means more than delivering a configured system. It means making sound solution decisions, reducing implementation complexity, ensuring consistent quality and helping customers realise lasting value from Autorola's software solutions.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Lead the analysis and translation of complex customer requirements and business processes into effective, scalable solution designs.

• Take ownership of the technical and functional solution approach throughout customer engagements, from initial assessment to implementation and validation.

• Design, configure and build Autorola software solutions, ensuring that they meet business needs and align with product capabilities, architecture and standards.

• Act as a trusted advisor to customers, challenging assumptions, clarifying requirements and recommending solutions that balance business value, feasibility and long-term sustainability.

• Provide senior solution input during project scoping, including technical effort estimates, dependency assessments, risk identification and evaluation of alternative approaches.

• Work closely with Project Management Consultants to ensure that solution decisions support realistic plans, predictable delivery and successful customer outcomes.

• Assess the fit between customer-specific requirements and standard product functionality, identifying when configuration, process adaptation or new development is the most appropriate approach.

• Collaborate with Product Management and Software Development (ASYS) to shape, clarify and qualify enhancement requests and development requirements.

• Take responsibility for solution quality, including configuration standards, test planning, validation and the resolution of functional and technical issues.

• Support customers' operational teams in adopting new solutions and ensuring that implemented functionality works effectively in their day-to-day business.

• Identify opportunities to improve implementation efficiency, solution consistency and reuse through templates, standards, guidelines and proven practices.

• Act as a senior sparring partner and knowledge resource for colleagues, supporting the development of solution expertise and promoting knowledge sharing across the organisation.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our consulting methods, delivery processes and collaboration across Business System Consulting, Project Management, Product Management and Software Development.

**Who are we looking for?

**We're looking for an experienced Senior Business System Consultant who combines strong business acumen with substantial solution consulting experience, sound technical judgement and the ability to guide customers and colleagues through complex implementation challenges.

You can move confidently between business processes, product capabilities and technical considerations. You know how to challenge requirements constructively, make informed trade-offs and turn complexity into clear, actionable solution designs.

**You Likely Have

**

• Several years of relevant experience in business systems consulting, solution consulting, software implementation, business process consultancy or a similar client-facing role.

• A proven track record of leading or taking significant ownership of complex system implementations and solution designs.

• Strong experience translating complex business requirements into practical, scalable and maintainable software solutions.

• Extensive experience with system configuration, functional design, testing and implementation quality.

• The ability to assess solution alternatives, evaluate technical and functional trade-offs, and make well-founded recommendations.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a structured and pragmatic approach to decision-making.

• The confidence to advise customers, challenge assumptions and communicate complex topics clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.

• Experience collaborating with Project Management, Software Development, Product Management and other cross-functional teams.

• The ability to identify implementation risks, dependencies and opportunities early, helping create more predictable and efficient delivery.

• A continuous improvement mindset and an interest in developing shared standards, best practices and team capabilities.

• The ability to balance individual customer needs with standard functionality, product consistency and long-term maintainability.

• A willingness to travel internationally for customer engagements when required.

Experience with enterprise software, IT consulting, Agile environments or the automotive industry is an advantage. Experience mentoring colleagues or contributing to the development of consulting practices is also beneficial.

**What Success Looks Like

**Within your first 12–18 months, you'll have:

• Established yourself as a trusted senior advisor to customers on complex business processes, solution design and product capabilities.

• Successfully led the solution design and technical delivery of complex customer implementations.

• Built a strong understanding of Autorola's products, business processes, technical capabilities and strategic priorities.

• Helped Project Management Consultants scope customer engagements more accurately through sound technical assessments, effort estimates and early risk identification.

• Improved solution quality, consistency and maintainability through clear design principles and well-founded technical and functional decisions.

• Strengthened collaboration between customers, Business System Consulting, Project Management, Software Development (ASYS), Product Management, Sales and our subsidiaries.

• Contributed to more efficient implementations through reusable solutions, improved templates, standards and best practices.

• Shared your experience and expertise to strengthen the capabilities of the wider consulting team.

• Helped customers adopt their solutions successfully and realise measurable value in their day-to-day operations.

**Why join Autorola Group?

**Autorola Group is a global company with more than 850 employees across 20 subsidiaries in Europe, Latin America and Asia-Pacific.

At Autorola Solutions, you'll join an international environment where project management, business process expertise and software development come together to solve complex challenges for leading automotive companies.

As a Senior Business System Consultant, you'll have a significant influence on how we design and deliver customer solutions. You'll work across organisational and geographical boundaries, collaborate with experienced colleagues and help shape the standards, methods and practices that support our continued growth.

We also offer pension and health insurance, social and company events, a great lunch arrangement, access to a fitness room and a lively Friday bar.

**Want to join the team?

**We're looking to fill the position as soon as possible. Please note that this description reflects our ideal candidate profile. We strongly believe in inclusion and diversity and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

Applications and CVs will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the advertisement may be removed once the right candidate has been found.

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Christian Gless, Tech Talent Acquisition Partner, at csg@autorola.com.

We store summer sun for the winter. Now Photoncycle is heading into thousands of Danish homes, and we are looking for a trainee who wants to help build the market from the ground up. Is that you?

About Photoncycle

Solar panels produce plenty of power in summer and very little in winter, when we need it most. Photoncycle solves that problem: we store the energy in a tank in the ground next to the house, so the household can use it for electricity and heating all winter. Surplus power is sold on the electricity market, where it helps balance supply and demand. The household pays a fixed monthly fee, and we build, install and operate the system.

We are 25 employees with offices in Oslo and Copenhagen. In 2026 we raised a €15 million Series A led by NordicNinja and Voima Ventures. We are now moving from full-scale pilot to commercial rollout, and the first phase of our production plant is underway.

Photoncycle is a completely new technology, and Denmark is our first market.

Why this role

As a trainee, you will be part of building Photoncycle's Danish operations, from research and permit processes to partner dialogues, pilot customers and events. You will work across the full breadth of a market launch and get hands-on experience with how a new energy technology is brought to market in Denmark.

The role is deliberately broad, and the scope will be tailored to the number of hours you work. Tasks will shift as the launch gets closer, and your responsibilities will grow with the role down the line.

What you will do

This is a versatile, hands-on role that mixes research, relationships and the nuts-and-bolts work. You will report to Anne Clara Laugesen, General Manager of Photoncycle Denmark, and work closely with our colleagues in Oslo.

Tasks and responsibility will include:

Market build and operations support

• 
Support our pilot customer programme, from first contact to onboarding

• 
Follow and assist with permit processes and dialogues with municipalities and authorities

• 
Help build and maintain relationships with customers, partners and stakeholders

• 
Take part in preparing test sites and the first installations

Research and analysis

• 
Desk research on municipalities, funding schemes, partners and competitors

• 
Monitor funding and grant opportunities

• 
Collect and structure data and recurring customer questions for internal use

Events and meetings

• 
Practical planning of customer meetings, community events and site visits: invitations, sign-ups, venue, catering and follow-up

• 
Prepare material and logistics for conferences and external events the team attends

What you bring

We imagine you being structured and comfortable juggling many small tasks at once. You take ownership, spot what needs to be done, and ask when something is unclear.

We expect you to:

• 
Be studying, or recently graduated, in a relevant field such as business, energy, engineering, public administration or similar

• 
Write and speak Danish fluently and work comfortably in English

• 
Be confident with Office tools and quick to pick up new systems

• 
Handle confidential information, including customer data, with care

It is a plus if you:

• 
Have an interest in the energy transition, energy systems or the Danish energy market

• 
Have experience from a startup, student job or association work with admin or coordination

• 
Are used to working with AI tools

You don't need to be an energy expert. What matters most is that you enjoy building something new where the right answer isn't known yet – so apply even if you can't tick every box.

What we offer

• 
A front-row seat to building a new energy company in Denmark ahead of a 2027 launch

• 
Close daily collaboration with the GM and real responsibility from day one

• 
Insight into regulation, permits, partnerships and go-to-market in the energy sector

• 
A small, international team with colleagues in Norway

• 
An office in the heart of Copenhagen at BloxHub, with a great lunch setup and free coffee

Start and application

The position can be set up in three ways: as a paid student job (15–37 hours a week), as an internship as part of your studies, or as virksomhedspraktik via your jobcentre if you have recently graduated and are currently unemployed. Hours and tasks are tailored to the arrangement. The start date is yesterday – or whenever you're ready, really.

We will be taking interviews as applications come in.

Photoncycle is committed to an inclusive workplace and hires based on skills, experience and potential. We encourage everyone interested to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnic background, religion or disability.

We look forward to hearing from you!

We’re looking for a commercially minded Legal Counsel to join us on our journey to become one stronger, more integrated SaaS business. You’ll work across commercial contracts, privacy and cybersecurity in the European and North American market, partnering with colleagues across the organisation to find practical solutions and support our growth.

Reporting to our General Counsel, you’ll work at the intersection of commercial law, privacy, cybersecurity and business transformation. You’ll play a key role in enabling business growth, supporting complex customer deals, and ensuring that our legal commitments are practical, proportionate and aligned with how we operate.

Whether you’re building on your experience in private practice or looking to grow further in an in-house role, this is an opportunity for you to take ownership, learn along the way, and make a real difference.

We are open to on-site (offices in Copenhagen and Wrocław), hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET), plus the US East Coast.

**About Us

**Cookie Information, Piwik PRO, and Sheltr, are leading SaaS brands specialising in privacy-first compliance and analytics. Together, we’re building intuitive, user-friendly products that help organisations navigate data privacy and marketing insights. With headquarters in Copenhagen and an office in Wrocław, our teams have been working across various industries to build trusted data privacy solutions since 2011.

We’re bringing our brands closer together to build one company with a shared identity in the group, a clear focus and ambitious plan for the future. The Legal, Compliance and Cybersecurity team has a core role to play in making that happen.

The role

These will be your main tasks:

Handle commercial contracts, particularly sales contracts

• Draft, review and negotiate customer contracts for EU and US customers.

• Support partner, reseller and supplier agreements, as well as more specialised regulatory requirements such as DORA-related terms and US healthcare BAAs.

• Work closely with Sales and Account Management to find solutions that support our commercial goals while managing legal risks.

Privacy compliance and cybersecurity

• Support GDPR compliance, international data transfers, sub-processor management and relevant UK and US privacy requirements.

• Work with our Cybersecurity team on NIS2 compliance and related contractual requirements.

• Help our Cyber Security and Compliance teams to respond to customer privacy and security questionnaires, audits and due diligence requests.

• Advise Product teams on privacy, consent and data protection, helping ensure that our commitments reflect how we actually work.

Help shape the way we work

• Improve legal templates, processes and ways of working as the business grows.

• Collaborate with colleagues across Sales, Product, Security, Finance and Operations.

• Contribute to shaping our legal function and how we support the wider business.

**About You

**You’re a structured, independent, and commercially minded lawyer who enjoys working with people and finding practical solutions. You combine sound legal judgement with a practical understanding of how a business operates. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, thinking creatively and making decisions, even when the answer isn’t entirely straightforward.

You know that good legal advice is not just about identifying risks; it’s about helping the business understand those risks and finding a way forward.

You bring:

• 2-5 years of experience with commercial contracts, gained in-house or at a law firm.

• An understanding of B2B contracting and an interest in SaaS or technology businesses.

• Working knowledge of GDPR and privacy law in a commercial context, or relevant experience with HIPAA and US privacy law.

• The ability to communicate clearly, and comfortable working directly with Sales on live deals and making pragmatic judgement calls.

• Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves

• Experience with cybersecurity regulations (NIS2 and/or DORA).

• Experience with HIPAA, including negotiating BAAs.

• Knowledge of corporate governance, employment/HR legal matters (DK, PL, DE, and/or US).

• Experience with US customers and US commercial contracting, including state privacy laws and/or wiretap/tracking litigation risk.

• Experience building processes and templates in a growing legal function.

What we offer

• The opportunity to make a real impact. You’ll help shape a growing international SaaS business as it evolves towards a more integrated, enterprise-ready organisation. You won’t simply be maintaining existing processes; you’ll help develop the legal and commercial foundations for our next stage of growth.

• International exposure and commercial ownership. You’ll work on customer and partner relationships across the US and Europe, gaining exposure to complex commercial negotiations and a broad range of legal and regulatory challenges.

• The chance to broaden your expertise, take ownership of meaningful projects and grow with the business.

• Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.

• A positive, informal workplace.

Application process

We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today.

This is what our recruitment process looks like:

• A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)

• An in-depth interview with the General Counsel and a stakeholder from the company (online)

• A final interview with our General Counsel including a live case (online or in-person, TBD)

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.
